label: Этаж
description: A 10-sentence usage card for этаж (floor; story).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Этаж' is the masculine nominative subject. 'Верхний' is the agreeing masculine adjective, and 'самый' forms the superlative.

missions.phrase: Лифт быстро поднял нас на этаж.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Accusative of direction. 'Этаж' is the accusative after 'на', showing motion up to the floor. 'Лифт' is the nominative subject, and 'нас' is the accusative object.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'Этаже' is the prepositional after 'на', stating which floor. 'Третьем' agrees in the masculine prepositional.

missions.phrase: Окна нашего этажа выходят в сад.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Этажа' is the genitive showing whose windows. 'Нашего' agrees in the masculine genitive, and 'окна' is the nominative subject.

missions.phrase: С верхнего этажа видно весь город.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive of origin. 'Этажа' is the genitive after 'с', showing the vantage point. 'Верхнего' agrees in the masculine genitive.
Strategic focus: Dative after 'по'. 'Этажу' is the dative after 'по', showing movement around the floor. 'Дети' is the nominative plural subject.
Strategic focus: Instrumental plural after 'между'. 'Этажами' is the instrumental plural after 'между', meaning between the floors. 'Лестница' is the nominative subject.

missions.phrase: В этом доме целых десять этажей.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive plural after a numeral. 'Этажей' is the genitive plural required after 'десять'. 'Целых' stresses the count, and 'в этом доме' sets the location.

missions.phrase: Нам нужно подняться на пятый этаж.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Accusative of direction. 'Этаж' is the accusative after 'на', marking the goal of going up. 'Пятый' agrees in the masculine accusative, and 'нам нужно' frames the task.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'Этаже' is the prepositional after 'на', placing the pharmacy. 'Первом' agrees in the masculine prepositional, and 'аптека' is the nominative subject.
